## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-7: unit tests written and passing (deviations portion)

## Description
Failing tests for `build_deviations(item, existing_deviations, fk_max) -> list[dict]`. Cases: failing fk with no existing reason -> reason='unjustified'; failing fk with existing reason preserved verbatim; passing item -> [].

## Given/When/Then
Given item with fk_grade=12 and existing_deviations=[{'rule_id':'fk_grade','reason':'statute mandates legal phrasing'}]; When build_deviations(item, existing, fk_max=8); Then returns list with one deviation, rule_id='fk_grade', reason='statute mandates legal phrasing' (preserved).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/test-batched.sh --runner=pytest --test-dir=plugins/dso/tests/scripts/
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/dso-lint.sh
- [ ] Format check passes
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/dso-format-check.sh
- [ ] RED test fails with ImportError
  Verify: pytest plugins/dso/tests/scripts/test_gov_copy_postprocess.py -k build_deviations 2>&1 | grep -E '(ImportError|ModuleNotFoundError|AttributeError)' || true

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/tests/scripts/test_gov_copy_postprocess.py: Edit

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
